description: fcntl subset (POSIX-gap list). userspace/ctests/musl_fcntl.c + toolchains/dunit-musl/src/fcntl/fcntl.c: F_DUPFD on the Dunit Dup syscall; F_GETFD/F_SETFD (FD_CLOEXEC) and F_GETFL/F_SETFL (status flags) via the new Dunit Fcntl syscall (86), which keeps per-fd flag state (kernel/src/process/mod.rs FdEntry.cloexec/.status); O_NONBLOCK is honoured on pipe reads. Operates on fd 1. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_fcntl_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: F_DUPFD produced a working duplicate fd (a write through it reached stdout)
the duplicate fd honoured the requested floor (>=10)
F_SETFD/F_GETFD store and return FD_CLOEXEC per fd
F_GETFL/F_SETFL round-trip the status flags (O_NONBLOCK set then read back)

forbidden.why: F_DUPFD did not return a working fd at/above the floor
F_GETFL/F_SETFL did not round-trip the status flags
